dimensions.note: No credentials or tokens are stored or logged. gh/git authenticate themselves; the behavior passes repo slugs, PR numbers, prompts, and workdirs only.
List/review/sync/summary steps and the preflight log with structured placeholders (repo, batch size, PR count, missing tool). Agent stderr is not logged verbatim as a secret-bearing blob.

This release adds checkToolAvailable/preflightTools, which fail fast naming a missing git/gh/agent binary before a step instead of surfacing an opaque mid-sweep subprocess failure; a non-zero --version exit still counts as present. The verdict-file read catch is deliberately narrow (agent may write nothing; stdout parsing still applies), and runModel/agent failures throw rather than being swallowed.

pr_sweep_test.ts covers batching, queue/explicit repo-pair resolution, normalizeRun defaults and model propagation, verdict tallying, the composable method surface, and the new preflight checks with an injected probe. End-to-end gh/agent flows remain workflow integration tests.

The composable steps are re-runnable: list refreshes open PRs, review writes per-PR results, sync re-reads state, and verdict/summary overwrite current resources. Per-PR instance names keep a re-run from mixing results across PRs.

gh/git CLI output is parsed defensively (derivePrState tolerates missing fields; unreadable PR state falls back to UNKNOWN_PR_STATE), and the new preflight validates the binaries before their output is relied on.

The review verdict temp dir is removed in a finally block (best effort), subprocesses use awaited output(), and no long-lived handles are created. Per-PR worktrees are owned by the agent-task dispatch layer.

All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); the optional model field is declared on the pair/step settings and result schemas.
Open-PR, per-PR, sweep, and summary resources declare bounded lifetimes and garbageCollection; the summary/current records are retained for operator inspection.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model: it is a run-based review/sync pipeline with composable steps and a one-call sweep convenience.
The new preflightTools checks git, gh, and (when needed) the selected agent in list, review, and sync, and fails with the missing tool's name before any step runs.
open-prs uses a fixed current instance, per-PR resources use prInstanceName(upstreamRepo, number), and sweep/summary use stable current names; no shape collisions.
Steps read the stored open-PR/queue records they own via readResource and pass results forward; no direct dataRepository access.
